# six6

> six6 is a zero-dependency, file-based memory and cognition toolkit for AI agents (built for OpenClaw). Six independent Python modules give an agent short- and long-term memory, nightly reflection, daydream-style idea generation, an idea lifecycle "topic lab", an inbox task loop, and a cron heartbeat — all communicating only through Markdown and JSONL files.

Modules (they never import each other):

- skill-memory: short-term context (NOW.md), daily episodic notes (memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md) and core memory (MEMORY.md).
- skill-meditation: nightly reflection that consolidates daily memory into MEMORY.md (needs an LLM API).
- skill-daydream: samples past memory fragments to generate idea seeds (needs an LLM API).
- skill-topic-lab: tracks idea seeds and their maturity; mature seeds can become GitHub Issues via `gh`.
- skill-autoloop: processes data/inbox.jsonl and dispatches tasks or escalations.
- skill-monitor: pulse entrypoint (heartbeat, daily, nightly, idle) for cron or systemd.

File protocol: data/inbox.jsonl (queue), data/topic-lab-seeds.jsonl (seeds), NOW.md, MEMORY.md, memory/, data/evolution.md. Closed loop: daydream -> topic-lab -> inbox -> autoloop -> water (topic-lab).

## Key commands

- `python3 runtime/scripts/six6.py init --base-dir /path/to/agent/root`
- `python3 runtime/scripts/six6.py validate --base-dir /path/to/agent/root`
- `python3 runtime/scripts/six6.py doctor --base-dir /path/to/agent/root`
- `python3 runtime/scripts/six6.py pulse heartbeat --base-dir /path/to/agent/root`
